Add work

/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/work
Roles: studentScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S06

Prepare permitted file/PDF or camera pages for one assignment attempt. Draft capture/import never submits, and mobile web never promises background upload or durable offline storage.

Use filesContinue to browser camera
Permissions
  • Only current eligible attempt can be prepared; staff preview cannot submit.
  • Group target and membership must be revalidated before W21.
  • No automatic cloud-drive connection or full photo-library access.
Responsive
  • Work tray is one column on narrow web; controls have touch targets.
  • Camera preview scales without requiring portrait-only orientation.
Accessibility
  • File input remains usable without drag/drop or camera.
  • Page thumbnails have textual position/file names; movement announces new order.
Data
  • Draft item IDs, file metadata, order/tags and processing status.
  • Attempt target and assignment version; browser retention capability explicitly modelled.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Camera denial still allows completion with permitted PDF upload.
  • Offline preparation never displays Received or a receipt reference.
  • Removing/reordering pages changes review payload while earlier received attempts remain unchanged.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
